entities.summary: The Azov Museum of History, Archaeology and Palaeontology in Azov, Rostov oblast, is a museum reserve in Russia. It is one of the largest museums in the south of Russia, particularly notable for its palaeontological collection. Azov History, Archaeology and Paleontology Museum-Reserve is a museum in Europe, established in 1917-05-17. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
